title: Prospective compact decoder-visible prediction of the deep midpoint residual

hypothesis.claim: One fixed 4,096-weight hashed linear correction built only from decoder-visible segment state predicts enough F-minus-O branch-logit residual to improve quantized held-out O truth-path ideal bits on validation, test, every test third, and against a shifted-label control.
hypothesis.minimumInterpretation: A pass authorizes testing the same fixed correction interface against one open Gamma base predictor; it does not authorize a codec or inherit the O teacher endpoint.
excludedInterpretations: The O teacher probability is an allowed submitted-codec input
held-out ideal-bit improvement equals arithmetic archive savings
the fixed learner may be tuned after validation or test inspection
a pass transfers beyond the frozen population or pays its source cost

population.selection: All aligned F/O rows define chronology; fitting and scoring use only second-half truth branches under frozen segment partitions.
population.coordinate: Original transformed-symbol ordinal with contiguous 64-symbol segments.

arms.mechanism: Full-update teacher probabilities provide residual targets only.
Output-head-only probabilities are the frozen scoring offset, never a promoted input.

changedVariables: The treatment adds one fixed quantized hashed-linear correction predicted from prior decoded symbols, segment position, branch index, and already-decoded branch prefix; the zero and shifted-label controls do not use aligned residual labels.
invariants: No feature reads the current symbol, current truth bit before prediction, future symbol, F probability, O probability, teacher hidden state, or validation/test label.
O probability is used only after prediction as a scoring offset and cannot appear in the serialized correction model.
Only train segments update weights; validation and test are single sealed evaluations.
All hyperparameters, partitions, clipping, features, quantization, controls, and gates are frozen in this contract before execution.
The shifted control uses the same learner and features; each train record receives the next train segment's residual at the same flattened branch ordinal modulo that target segment's branch count.
Only quantized-model measurements enter promotion predicates and all evidence receives zero objective credit.

observableInputs: branch index and branch-prefix bits decoded before the current bit
previous one and two decoded transformed symbols
sixteen-bin signed-free count sketch of the segment first half
forbiddenInputs: current truth bit before probability emission
F or O probability as a correction-model feature
teacher logits hidden activations parameters or gradients
validation or test residual targets during fitting

measurements.definition: Exact F/O row, symbol, topology, and truth-path identity.
Static and runtime audit that every model feature is decoder-visible before the predicted branch.
Only train-segment labels update either treatment or shifted-control weights.
All reported promoted measurements use the serialized int16 model reloaded from bytes.
Validation O truth-path bits minus quantized-corrected truth-path bits.
Sealed test O truth-path bits minus quantized-corrected truth-path bits.
Minimum test gain over three contiguous test-segment thirds.
Quantized treatment test gain minus quantized shifted-label-control test gain.
Fraction of sealed test segments with positive quantized treatment gain.
Serialized float64 scale plus 4,096 little-endian int16 weights.

gates.passConsequence: Authorize one exact experiment applying this unchanged correction interface to probabilities from one open Gamma predictor on a newly bound population.
gates.failConsequence: Retire this exact 4,096-weight hashed-linear formulation without dimension, feature, epoch, learning-rate, clipping, partition, or quantization sweeps.

protocol.algorithm: Four-epoch normalized online squared-error regression of clipped F-minus-O branch logits, followed by float64-scale plus int16 quantization and sealed ideal-bit replay.

controls.mechanism: Use the unchanged O truth-path probabilities.
Fit the identical model with each train target taken from the next train segment at the same flattened branch ordinal modulo target-segment branch count.
